premise: For weeks Leo has watched one bud in its sealed box; the morning it opens orange, he radios everyone to come and see.
inspiration: Andersen's 'Thumbelina', where a flower opens to reveal a tiny girl, turned: nobody tiny inside — the flower itself is the marvel.
lesson: Patient care is worth the wait.
learning: Zinnias like this one have really bloomed in space, on a space station.

en-US.title: The First Flower
en-US.text: Every morning for weeks, {man:enter} Leo had visited one small green {flower:enter} bud. It lived in a sealed box of its own, safe from the cold and the empty sky, under a pink-purple lamp. {flower:pulse} {man:live} Each day he checked its water, its warmth, its air. And each day… still a bud. {man:face sad} [sighs] The {greenhouse:enter} greenhouse was full of lettuce and tomatoes. {greenhouse:wobble} But Leo wanted a flower. [short pause] One morning he came loping up… and {man:face surprised} stopped. {flower:live hold} The bud had opened and turned up to its light: round, bright orange, petal upon petal. {man:says} [in awe] “Oh. Hello, you.” {man:face happy} {man:hop} He grabbed his {sfx:radio} radio. {man:says} [excited] “Come and see, quick! We've got a flower!” [warmly] {greenhouse:glow 0.5} Zinnias like this one had bloomed before, on a space station high above the Earth. But this one was theirs. {flower:sparkle} {man:hearts} {man:says} [softly] “Welcome to the Moon.”

es-ES.title: La primera flor
es-ES.text: Cada mañana, durante semanas, {man:enter} Leo había visitado un pequeño {flower:enter} capullo verde. Vivía en su propia caja sellada, a salvo del frío y del cielo vacío, bajo una lámpara rosa y morada. {flower:pulse} {man:live} Cada día le revisaba el agua, el calor, el aire. Y cada día… seguía siendo un capullo. {man:face sad} [sighs] El {greenhouse:enter} invernadero estaba lleno de lechugas y tomates. {greenhouse:wobble} Pero Leo quería una flor. [short pause] Una mañana llegó dando saltos… y {man:face surprised} se paró en seco. {flower:live hold} El capullo se había abierto y miraba hacia su luz: redondo, naranja brillante, pétalo sobre pétalo. {man:says} [in awe] «Vaya. Hola, preciosa.» {man:face happy} {man:hop} Agarró la {sfx:radio} radio. {man:says} [excited] «¡Ven a ver, rápido! ¡Tenemos una flor!» [warmly] {greenhouse:glow 0.5} Otras cinias como esta ya habían florecido, en una estación espacial muy por encima de la Tierra. Pero esta era suya. {flower:sparkle} {man:hearts} {man:says} [softly] «Bienvenida a la Luna.»
